title: Spindle: continuous workload profiler and heuristic-driven batching recommender with guarded commit and staged rollback
creator: Ethan Patel
description:
Goal: Build 'Spindle', a continuous workload profiler paired with a heuristic-driven batching recommender that can safely propose, shadow-apply, and gradually commit batching/caching configuration changes with automatic rollback triggers and human-in-loop approval lanes.

Context: We already have several components that sample workload signatures and apply batch profiles (profilers, fingerprinters, policy appliers). Spindle's scope is to combine a streaming workload census, drift detection, cost-signal blending, and a staged commit pipeline that allows small canary lanes, synthetic challenge tests, and automatic circuit-breaker rollback based on latency/regression thresholds. The feature should be usable across Hosted and Dedicated deployments and be compatible with existing KV-cache windowing heuristics.

Non-goals: Full RL-driven optimization in this ticket (we will keep to heuristics + param annealing). This ticket does not include the UI pages for multi-tenant RBAC (console work will be tracked separately).
acceptance_criteria: Spindle can ingest per-route request traces and produce a 24-hour workload signature summary within 2 hours of processing for new routes
Recommender produces an ordered list of batching/caching candidate profiles (batch_size, microbatch_window_ms, kv_prefix_cache_ttl) with expected cost delta and latency delta estimates
Shadow apply mode: new profile can be applied in shadow (no real traffic) and generate telemetry comparing baseline vs proposed for at least 10k requests before promotion
Canary lanes: allow staged commit to 1% -> 10% -> 50% traffic with automatic pause/rollback if P95 latency regresses > 12% or error rate increases > 0.5% above baseline
Rollback automation: system auto-rolls back if synthetic challenge workload fails or if telemetry gating trips; rollback must be observable in Console and emit an incident event
Documentation: PRD and operator runbook links present in ticket and accessible to SRE and solutions teams
success_metrics: Platform-wide per-token cost reduction attributable to Spindle recommendations >= 3% within 90 days on opt-in clusters
False-positive rollback rate < 5% (i.e., Spindle should not rollback safe changes frequently)
Average time-to-suggest for new routes < 2 hours
Number of routes safely upgraded via staged commit >= 75% of proposals after two-week trial
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Lab: implement profiling pipeline and offline recommender, run against historical traces (2 weeks)
Phase 1 - Shadow: deploy recommender in shadow apply mode for a subset of internal tenants and Dedicated test clusters (3 weeks)
Phase 2 - Canary: enable staged commit for low-risk routes with telemetry gating and synthetic challenge tests (2 weeks)
Phase 3 - Gradual opt-in: open to customers with explicit opt-in, collect metrics and reduce conservative thresholds as confidence grows (ongoing)
Contingency: if rollout sees latency regressions above tolerated threshold, trigger full stop and rollback to prior stable profiles while issuing customer communications
telemetry_required: per-profile cost estimate and actual token counts
KV-cache hit/miss rates and prefix-level evictions
shadow vs baseline delta metrics stored for 30 days
comments: 2026-02-12 - Ethan Patel: Created initial PRD and scoped MVP. Key unknowns: safe thresholds for canary commits and how to synthesize representative challenge workloads for each route.
2026-02-16 - Marisol Chen: Implemented streaming sampler prototype. Observed heavy diurnal variance in a subset of routes; will add temporal bucketing to signatures.
2026-02-20 - Rahul Singh (SRE): Reviewed failure modes. Recommended adding a hard circuit-breaker at the node/pool level in addition to route-level gating to avoid noisy neighbor cascade.
2026-02-25 - Design review (Ava Martinez): Suggested UI flows for manual approval and override; design ticket created (DES-3021) to handle console UX.

2026-03-01 - Marisol Chen: Shadow apply run against internal-prod for 7 days. Summary: median cost delta -4.1% for text-generation routes, P95 latency delta +2%. No rollbacks triggered in shadow. Uploading telemetry snapshot to Drive.
2026-03-03 - Product review (Nora Blake): Asked for clearer guardrail thresholds and mandatory synthetic challenge before 10% canary. Updated rollout plan accordingly.

2026-03-07 - Marisol Chen: Implemented staged commit controller with pause/resume APIs. Added automatic rollback on P95 > 12% regression or error-rate delta > 0.5%. Moving ticket to In Progress and starting Canary phase for two internal tenants.
